plan.notes: Source: official College of Southern Idaho 2024-2025 catalog, 'Pharmacy (PRE), Associate of Science' program page (Major Code: 2004S), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02 from https://csi.smartcatalogiq.com/en/2024-2025/2024-2025-catalog/engineering-physical-and-computer-sciences-department/pharmacy-pre/pharmacy-pre-associate-of-science . Transcription method: fetched the official program page and transcribed the published requirement tables verbatim (course codes, titles, credits, printed semester totals).  TRUE award: Associate of Science (page title 'Pharmacy (PRE), Associate of Science'). Catalog year 2024-2025: the newest CSI catalog with complete published program pages found (a 2025-2026 catalog exists but its program pages were not locatable; the 2024-2025 pages are complete and officially published). Total credits: 73, the catalog's published total ('Total Credit Hours: 73'); semester tables print 17/18/18/20 and sum exactly. Choice slots: 'ECON 201 Principles of Macroeconomics OR ECON 202 Principles of Microeconomics' (both 3 cr); COMM GE / HUMA GE / SOCS GE / HUMA GE2 / WELL GE are official catalog placeholders (student choice). Footnotes: Social Science courses must be from 2 different disciplines; Humanities courses must be from 2 different disciplines. The catalog notes 'Alternative plans of study available by contacting your advisor.' Prereqs: left empty. The catalog marks courses with '*' as 'Prerequisite or corequisite required' but does not name the prerequisite on the plan page; per-course prerequisites live on the official catalog course pages, not the plan page.
